related_resources.reason: Analyzes the 1358 Canggu Ferry Charter, river crossings and shifts from older revenue taxes to pamuja; chapter was indexed but website now shows only navigation in reader view.
Presents the 1365 Deśawarṇana and a series of dated charters including the 1358 ferry and later commercial grants; table of contents reviewed, not whole four-volume edition.
Studies sima land privileges, jayasong judicial decisions and interactions between royal court and village notables; law records emphasize litigants recognized by authority.
Reviews sima/swatantara tax exemptions and why royal grants were a means of strengthening local supporters and negotiated authority.
Supplementary article for orientation only; no historical claim relies on this source.
